_: Pickpocketing, the one roll (decision 0151 item 4; world/76 section 118 intro). Skyrim's chance, rebuilt as rows (lore topics/skyrim-sneak-detection.md section Pickpocket): base = 15 + Sneak (capped 90, MaxChance) sampled at the Sneak bands; the target's spot takes 0.25 a point (TargetSkillMult -0.25); weight takes 4 a kilogram (WeightMult -4), carried as the penalty at each weight class's top edge; value takes 1 per 10 gold (AmountMult -0.1) at each value band's lower edge. Worn armour is never taken. The roll is seeded from the save's rng stream per attempt. `worldgen.stealth_views` writes the runtime view.
